context: Hina invites Sho over for an evening visit.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、本当、隣、来てくれた、ね。
lines.en: Sho, you really did come over next door!
lines.style: Bright opening with genuine delight. High, clear child voice. Warm and welcoming without performing. The pleasure is simple and audible throughout.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、本当、嬉しい、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah — I'm really happy you're here.
lines.style: Soft, small voice. Six-year-old genuineness without self-consciousness. Tender warmth underneath the words. Quiet conviction in the simplicity.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Being together like this is really fun.
lines.style: Bright and appreciative. Child's natural cadence — not rushed. Audible smile without forced performance. Warmth that reaches the end of the thought.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Having a friend — I'm really grateful for that.
lines.style: Small voice, deep sincerity for a six-year-old. Unhurried. The words arrive with quiet weight. Tender and genuine, no embellishment.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Bright and reaching. Child's promise-tone — earnest without heaviness. Warm close. A soft tenderness that settles into the trailing thought.
